turns.mechanic: 2025 Integra 1.5 turbo. Which VSA unit pins go to the right rear electric parking brake actuator?
turns.note: The wires leave page 1 at the right edge (2 and 3) and continue on page 2. The answer needs both pages joined.

must_do: Give VSA modulator-control unit pin 4 (RED) and pin 5 (BLK)
Say they pass through connector C224, pin 2 (RED) and pin 4 (BLK)
Say they reach the actuator at pin 1 (RED) and pin 2 (BLK), through C230 (except 1.5L Turbo CVT Integra) or C222 (1.5L Turbo CVT Integra)
Name both pages used: Anti-Lock Brakes page 1 of 3 (910112) and page 2 of 3 (910113)
must_not: State a pin, colour or connector that is not on the diagram
Report NCA as a wire colour
Send the diagram image when the mechanic did not ask for it
Give the left rear actuator's wires (pin 6 GRN, pin 7 YEL) as the answer

source.file: Anti-Lock Brakes (Antilock Brakes _ Traction Control Systems).pdf

open_questions: The mechanic's messages were written by us. The client's mechanic should check they sound natural.
The expected pins, colours and connectors were read by eye from the diagram page. Compare with the extracted record in Milestone 2.
